name: Tomato Leaf Curl
description: A viral disease transmitted by whiteflies that causes severe stunting, leaf curling, and yield loss. It is one of the most damaging tomato viruses in tropical regions.
symptoms: Upward curling and cupping of leaves
Yellowing along leaf margins and between veins
Stunted plant growth and reduced leaf size
Flower drop and reduced fruit set
Fruits may be small, misshapen, and unmarketable
causes: Tomato yellow leaf curl virus transmitted by whiteflies
High whitefly populations feeding on infected plants
Presence of alternative hosts (weeds, other solanaceous crops)
Dry season conditions favoring whitefly reproduction
treatments: No curative treatment for viral infection
Control whitefly vectors with insecticidal soap or neem oil
Use reflective mulches to repel whiteflies
Remove and destroy severely infected plants
prevention: Control whitefly populations with botanical insecticides
Remove alternative weed hosts around fields
Install yellow sticky traps for whitefly monitoring
